mapper.insert: INSERT INTO push_notification_logs ( user_id, sent_on, status, claimed_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{userId}, CURRENT_DATE, 'processing', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (user_id, sent_on) DO UPDATE SET status = 'processing', claimed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE push_notification_logs.status = 'failed'
mapper.update: UPDATE push_notification_logs SET status = 'sent', updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND sent_on = CURRENT_DATE
